subject: E2E mTLS validation & DNS ownership agreement for tenant-facing private link
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-cloud.com>, security@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: E2E mTLS validation & DNS ownership agreement for tenant-facing private link

Hi team,

Following up from last week's sync: Acme is preparing to cut over their tenant-facing private-link endpoints to use our mutual-TLS proxy in front of the dedicated on-prem runtime. Before we flip the records we need a short, agreed validation and maintenance plan that covers DNS split-brain, cert rotation windows, and proof artifacts for their SOC2 audit.

I've drafted a narrow test plan (attached: mtls-test-plan.md) that includes:
- a minimal night-time maintenance window for cert rotation and A/AAAA swap,
- a DNS sync checklist for split-horizon propagation and TTL rollback,
- an end-to-end request capture to verify client certs are presented and validated through the proxy.

Questions for confirmation:
1) Ownership: who in Acme will be the authoritative owner to perform the private-zone changes for tenant FQDNs (split-horizon authoritative change)?
2) Certificate rotation: we propose a 45-minute maintenance window during which both the old and new certs are accepted by the proxy (grace period). Is that acceptable?
3) Evidence: Acme needs the cert chain (PEM) and request captures for audit. We can provide the cert-chain-sample.pem and a sanitized trace.

Proposed maintenance windows (PDT):
- Primary: Sat Aug 22 00:30–01:15
- Backup: Sun Aug 23 02:00–02:45

Please review the attached and reply with: owner for DNS changes, confirmation on the window, and any additional compliance artifacts Acme needs.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0198

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: E2E mTLS validation & DNS ownership agreement for tenant-facing private link

Thanks Ben — overall this looks good. A few comments inline:
- Ownership: Acme confirmed DNS changes will be performed by their cloud-ops team (cc Alex). We need their point-of-contact for the exact private-zone names (they may have different zones per-region).
- TTL rollback: set to 60s at T-24h, then restore to 300s at T+24h. Add this to the dns-sync-checklist.pdf.
- Dual-cert acceptance: a 45-minute grace period is fine, but add an automated health-check that fails the cutover if 5xxs exceed 1% for 5 minutes.

Action items:
- Alex: please share the authoritative private-zone names and a preferred contact for DNS changes.
- Ben: once Alex confirms, schedule the runbook review with Infra SRE (Lauren) so we can sign off.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-cloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@finbank.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: E2E mTLS validation & DNS ownership agreement for tenant-facing private link

Marissa / Ben,

Confirming: Acme Cloud Ops will own the private-zone changes. Our POC for DNS is Priya N. (priya.n@acme-cloud.com). The zones in scope:
- tenant1.internal.acme-cloud.com (us-west)
- tenant1.eu.internal.acme-cloud.com (eu-central)

We accept the 45-minute dual-cert window. Two asks from our side:
1) We need the exact cert chain PEM before the window so our auditors can run independent validations.
2) Please provide an allowlist of source IPs (or a maintained host-name) that the proxy will use to reach our backends so we can lock down firewall rules.

Attached is our quick SOC evidence checklist (we redacted customer-specific data). We'll need the sanitized request-capture and the cert-chain-sample.pem mentioned in your email.

Alex Ramos
Cloud Ops Manager | Acme Cloud
alex.ramos@acme-cloud.com

Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: E2E mTLS validation & DNS ownership agreement for tenant-facing private link

Thanks all — I reviewed the attachments and the proposed windows. Approving primary window on Sat Aug 22 00:30–01:15 PDT with the following add-ons from Infra SRE:
- Run the pre-cutover health sweep at T-30m (synthetic traffic to 10 representative tenants).
- If health sweep fails, rollback with a documented abort checklist (included in mtls-test-plan.md).
- We will provide a one-hour on-call rotation for SRE during the window and produce the sanitized traces and HMAC'd cert-chain artifact for compliance.

Ben: please confirm Priya's contact (Alex listed Priya) and provide the cert-chain-sample.pem to Acme by EOD Mon Aug 16 so they can complete their audit step.

Lauren Bishop
Staff Infra SRE Lead | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.inference
